rules.name: xoga747-03-run-level-and-errors
rules.sql: SELECT execution_id, workflow_id, business_unit, start_time, end_time, total_duration, total_input_rows, final_output_rows FROM opera.pipeline_execution_level_log WHERE created_timestamp >= :since ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT execution_id, step_number, error_code, count(*) AS n, min(error_message) AS sample_message, min(root_cause) AS sample_cause FROM opera.pipeline_execution_error_log WHERE created_timestamp >= :since GROUP BY execution_id, step_number, error_code ORDER BY execution_id, step_number LIMIT 200

expect.reason: the runs of 23-24 Nov are in the level log
